title: Rama along with Lakshmana and Seetha ascend the aerial car
introduction: Rama commands Vibhishana to honour the monkeys with gold and precious stones. When Vibhishana has honoured them with the gifts, Rama along with Lakshmana and Seetha ascend the aerial car. When the monkeys and Vibhishana request Rama to permit them to accompany in the aerial car upto Ayodhya to witness his coronation-ceremony, Rama gladly permits them to do so. All of them start on their aerial journey in Pushpaka, the wonderful aerial car which can accommodate all, spaciously.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्वाविंशत्यधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 122nd chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
उपस्थितम् तु तं कृत्वा पुष्पकं पुष्पभूषितम् |
अविदूरे स्थितो राममित्युवाच विभीषणः
verses.iast:
upasthitam tu taṃ kṛtvā puṣpakaṃ puṣpabhūṣitam |
avidūre sthito rāmamityuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Keeping ready Pushpaka the aerial car decorated with flowers, Vibhishana, for his part, standing not very far, spoke to Rama (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
स तु बद्धाञ्जलिपुटो विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः |
अब्रवीत्त्वरयोपेतः किं करोमीति राघवम्
verses.iast:
sa tu baddhāJṇjalipuṭo vinīto rākṣaseśvaraḥ |
abravīttvarayopetaḥ kiṃ karomīti rāghavam
verses.translation: "What more can I do?" thus spoke with haste, Vibhishana endowed as he was with modesty and with joined palms, to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
तमब्रवीन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः |
विमृश्य राघवो वाचमिदं स्नेहपुरस्कृतम्
verses.iast:
tamabravīnmahātejā lakṣmaṇasyopaśṛṇvataḥ |
vimṛśya rāghavo vācamidaṃ snehapuraskṛtam
verses.translation: After some circumspection, Rama of great splendor, affectionately spoke the following words to him, while Lakshmana was listening:

verses.devanagari:
कृतप्रयत्नकर्माणः सर्व एव वनेचराः |
रत्नैरर्थैश्च विविधैः संपूज्यन्तां विभीषण
verses.iast:
kṛtaprayatnakarmāṇaḥ sarva eva vanecarāḥ |
ratnairarthaiśca vividhaiḥ sampūjyantāṃ vibhīṣaṇa
verses.translation: "Let all these monkeys and bears (ie. Denizens of forests), who performed tasks of exertion, be honoured with tasks of exertion, be honoured with precious stones and riches of various kinds, O Vibhishana!"

glosses.meaning: (Let) all these monkeys and bears (ie. Denizem of forests) kR^ita prayatna karmaaNaH = who performed tasks of exertion

verses.devanagari:
सहामीभिस्त्वया लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वर |
हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः
verses.iast:
sahāmībhistvayā laṇ^kā nirjitā rākṣaseśvara |
hṛṣṭaiḥ prāṇabhayaṃ tyaktvā saṅgrāmeṣvanivartibhiḥ
verses.translation: "O Vibhishana the king of demons! Lanka has conquered by you, in collaboration with these monkeys, who never turned their backs in battles and fought joyfully, ignoring all risk to their lives."

glosses.meaning: O Vibhishana the king of demons!

verses.devanagari:
त इमे कृतकर्माणः सर्व एव वनौकसः |
धनरत्नप्रदानेन कर्मैषां सफलं कुरु
verses.iast:
ta ime kṛtakarmāṇaḥ sarva eva vanaukasaḥ |
dhanaratnapradānena karmaiṣāṃ saphalaṃ kuru
verses.translation: "All these monkeys, without exceptions, have accomplished their task. Reward their achievement with gifts of gold and precious stones."

glosses.meaning: with gift of gold and precious stones.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् संमानिताश्चैते नन्द्यमाना यथा त्वया |
भविष्यन्ति कृतज्ञेन निर्विऋता हरियूथपाः
verses.iast:
evam saṃmānitāścaite nandyamānā yathā tvayā |
bhaviṣyanti kṛtajJṇena nirviṛtā hariyūthapāḥ
verses.translation: "Highly honoured in this way any duly cheered by you, acknowledging their services, the chiefs of monkey-troops, will feel happy."

verses.devanagari:
त्यागिनं संग्रहीतारं सानुक्रोशं जितेन्द्रियम् |
सर्वे त्वामभिगच्छन्ति ततः संबोधयामि ते
verses.iast:
tyāginaṃ saṅgrahītāraṃ sānukrośaṃ jitendriyam |
sarve tvāmabhigacchanti tataḥ sambodhayāmi te
verses.translation: "All will come nearer to you, for having possessed this quality of generosity, for propitiating them, for showing compassion to them and for having subjugated your senses. Hence, I am reminding you."

verses.devanagari:
हीनं रतिगुणैः सर्वैरभिहन्तारमाहवे |
सेना त्यजति संविग्ना नृपतिं तं नरेश्वर
verses.iast:
hīnaṃ ratiguṇaiḥ sarvairabhihantāramāhave |
senā tyajati saṃvignā nṛpatiṃ taṃ nareśvara
verses.translation: "O king! Feeling agitated, the army deserts that king, who is bereft of all loving qualities and who merely orders them to kill people in battle."

glosses.meaning: and who orders them to kill people

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वानरांस्तान्विभीषणः |
रत्नार्थसंविभागेन सर्वानेवाभ्यपूजयत्
verses.iast:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa vānarāṃstānvibhīṣaṇaḥ |
ratnārthasaṃvibhāgena sarvānevābhyapūjayat
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Vibhishana honoured all those monkeys, by dispersing precious stones and gold to them.

glosses.meaning: by dispersing precious stones and gold to them.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तान् पूजितान् दृष्ट्वा रत्नार्थैर्हरियूथपान् |
आरुरोह तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
tatastān pūjitān dṛṣṭvā ratnārthairhariyūthapān |
āruroha tadā rāmastadvimānamanuttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, having seen on that occasion all those commanders of monkey-troops honoured with precious stones and gold, Rama then mounted that excellent aerial car.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं लज्जमानां यशस्विनीम् |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता
verses.iast:
aṇ^kenādāya vaidehīṃ lajjamānāṃ yaśasvinīm |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vikrāntena dhanuṣmatā
verses.translation: He mounted the aerial car along with Lakshmana, his valiant brother wielding a bow and taking the illustrious Seetha, who was feeling abashed, in his arms.

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीत्स विमानस्थः पूजयन् सर्ववानरान् |
सुग्रीवं च महावीर्यम् काकुत्स्तः सविभीषणम्
verses.iast:
abravītsa vimānasthaḥ pūjayan sarvavānarān |
sugrīvaṃ ca mahāvīryam kākutstaḥ savibhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: Bestowing attention on all the monkeys as well as Vibhishana and the mighty Sugreeva, Rama remaining in the aerial car, spoke (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
मित्रकार्यम् कृतमिदं भवद्भिद्वानरर्षभाः |
अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टम् प्रतिगच्छत
verses.iast:
mitrakāryam kṛtamidaṃ bhavadbhidvānararṣabhāḥ |
anujJṇātā mayā sarve yatheṣṭam pratigacchata
verses.translation: "O the foremost of monkeys! This work of a friend has been accomplished by you. Permitted by me, all of you can go, where you will."

verses.devanagari:
यत्तु कार्यं वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च |
कृतं सुग्रीव तत्सर्वं भवता धर्मभीरुणा
किष्किन्धां प्रतियाह्यशु स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः |
verses.iast:
yattu kāryaṃ vayasyena snigdhena ca hitena ca |
kṛtaṃ sugrīva tatsarvaṃ bhavatā dharmabhīruṇā
kiṣkindhāṃ pratiyāhyaśu svasainyenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: "O Sugreeva! All that which ought to be done by an affectionate and service-minded friend, has been done for your part by you, trembling alive as you are to righteousness. Accompanied by your army, proceed to Kishkindha at once."

glosses.meaning: who are trembling alive to righteousness
by an affectionate and service-minded friend

verses.devanagari:
स्वराज्ये वस लङ्कायां मया दत्ते विभीषण
न त्वां धर्षयितुं शक्ताः सेन्द्रा अपि दिवौकसः |
verses.iast:
svarājye vasa laṇ^kāyāṃ mayā datte vibhīṣaṇa
na tvāṃ dharṣayituṃ śaktāḥ sendrā api divaukasaḥ |
verses.translation: "O Vibhishana! Settle down in your kingdom at Lanka, conferred by me. Even the celestials including Indra shall not be able to attack you."

verses.devanagari:
अयोध्यां प्रतियास्यामि राजधानीं पितुर्मम
अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छमि सर्वानामन्त्रयामि वः |
verses.iast:
ayodhyāṃ pratiyāsyāmi rājadhānīṃ piturmama
abhyanujJṇātumicchami sarvānāmantrayāmi vaḥ |
verses.translation: " I am going to Ayodhya, the seat of government of my father. I bid adieu to you and wish to take leave of you all."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तास्तु रामेण हरीन्द्रा हरयस्तथा
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः |
verses.iast:
evamuktāstu rāmeṇa harīndrā harayastathā
ūcuḥ prāJṇjalayaḥ sarve rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, the monkey-chiefs, the monkeys, Vibhishana the demon and all of them there, with their joined palms, spoke (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वान् नयतु नो भवान्
मुद्युक्ता विचरिष्यामो वनान्युपननानि च |
verses.iast:
ayodhyāṃ gantumicchāmaḥ sarvān nayatu no bhavān
mudyuktā vicariṣyāmo vanānyupananāni ca |
verses.translation: "We also wish to proceed to Ayodhya. You take all of us there we shall range the gardens and groves there with rejoice."

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकार्द्रं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च
अचिरादागमिष्यामः स्वगृहान्नृपसत्तम |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā tvāmabhiṣekārdraṃ kausalyāmabhivādya ca
acirādāgamiṣyāmaḥ svagṛhānnṛpasattama |
verses.translation: "O the excellent king! Seeing you, drench with ablution (in the coronation ceremony) and offering our salutations to Kausalya, we shall return to our homes."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तः स धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः
अब्रवीद्वानरान्रामः ससुग्रीवविभीषणान् |
verses.iast:
evamuktaḥ sa dharmātmā vānaraiḥ savibhīṣaṇaiḥ
abravīdvānarānrāmaḥ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇān |
verses.translation: Hearing those words of the monkeys and Vibhishana, that pious-minded Rama spoke to those monkeys, Sugreeva and Vibhishana as follows:

verses.devanagari:
प्रियाअत्प्रियतरं लब्धं यदहं ससुहृज्जनः
सर्वैर्भवद्भिः सहितः प्रीतिं लप्स्ये पुरीं गतः |
verses.iast:
priyāatpriyataraṃ labdhaṃ yadahaṃ sasuhṛjjanaḥ
sarvairbhavadbhiḥ sahitaḥ prītiṃ lapsye purīṃ gataḥ |
verses.translation: "Something more dearer than everything dear will be achieved by me, if I reach Ayodhya with the host of my friends along with all of you, for, I shall feel delighted."

glosses.meaning: with the host of my friends

verses.devanagari:
क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं वानरैः सह
त्वमप्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्र विभीषण |
verses.iast:
kṣipramāroha sugrīva vimānaṃ vānaraiḥ saha
tvamapyāroha sāmātyo rākṣasendra vibhīṣaṇa |
verses.translation: "O Sugreeva! Mount the aerial cars quickly, along with the monkeys. O Vibhishana, the king of demons! You also ascend it, along with your counsellors."

verses.devanagari:
ततह् स पुष्पकं दिव्यं सुग्रीवः सह वानरैः
आरुरोह मुदा युक्तः समात्यश्च विभीषणः |
verses.iast:
tatah sa puṣpakaṃ divyaṃ sugrīvaḥ saha vānaraiḥ
āruroha mudā yuktaḥ samātyaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Thereupon, that Sugreeva along with the monkeys gladly ascended that wonderful Pushpaka, the aerial car. Vibhishana together with his counselors also ascended it.

verses.devanagari:
तेष्वारूढेषु सर्वेषु कौबेरम् परमासनम्
राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातमुत्पपात विहायसम् |
verses.iast:
teṣvārūḍheṣu sarveṣu kauberam paramāsanam
rāghaveṇābhyanujJṇātamutpapāta vihāyasam |
verses.translation: When all of them ascended, that excellent aerial car, belonging to Kubera, flew into the sky, after having been duly authorized by Rama.

verses.devanagari:
खगतेन मिवानेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता
प्रहृष्टश्चप्रतीतश्च बभौ रामः कुबेरवत् |
verses.iast:
khagatena mivānena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā
prahṛṣṭaścapratītaśca babhau rāmaḥ kuberavat |
verses.translation: Feeling greatly rejoiced and satisfied while travelling in that splendid aerial car, which was now in the air and was provided with the image of a swan, Rama shone like Kubera.

glosses.meaning: while travelling in the splendid aerial car
which was now in the air
and was provided with the image of swan

verses.devanagari:
ते सर्वे वानरर्क्षश्च राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः
यथासुखमसंबाधं दिव्ये तस्मिन्नुपाविशन् |
verses.iast:
te sarve vānararkṣaśca rākṣasāśca mahābalāḥ
yathāsukhamasambādhaṃ divye tasminnupāviśan |
verses.translation: All those mighty monkeys, bears and demons sat comfortably and spaciously in that wonderful aerial car.
